data.purpose: Plates, trip ids, counts, and the clock.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action on a pane, such as New trip.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1a8cff 0%, #0066cc 100%); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 14px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12.5px; box-shadow: 0 8px 16px -8px rgba(0, 102, 204, 0.7), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3d9bff 0%, #0057b0 100%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0066cc; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); color: #1e293b; border: 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,0.1); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 14px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12.5px; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0066cc; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="Search trip, route, plate, driver" />
components.css: .ds-input { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); color: #0f172a; border: 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,0.14); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 13px; width: 240px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0066cc; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav item
components.description: Active item in the floating sidebar.
components.css: .ds-nav { background: rgba(0,102,204,0.14); color: #0066cc; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 11px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; } .ds-nav:hover { background: rgba(0,102,204,0.18); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0066cc; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status pill
components.description: A status word with a dot.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; background: rgba(255,149,0,0.16); color: #9a4d00; border: 1px solid rgba(154,77,0,0.25); border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-pill::before { content: ""; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Glass panel
components.html:
On site now

Seven trucks are in the yard.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.66); color: #0f172a; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.78); border-radius: 20px; padding: 14px 16px; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -8px rgba(15,23,42,0.1), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(180%); max-width: 280px; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: #475569; font-size: 13px; }

narrative.overview: CoreLogistics is a desk you can see the yard through. Panels are glass over an ambient mesh, not solid cards on a flat page. The same material wraps the control tower, the gate, the warehouse floor, and the driver cab. Tower screens keep the mock's jobs: live site, dispatch, fleet, designer, analytics. The other apps keep their own tasks inside that chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Three glass levels: default, strong, and subtle, each with blur, a hairline, and an inset highlight.
An ambient mesh of blue, purple, teal, and green, light by default and dark when the operator switches.
Apple hues for status, darkened where white or light text would fail contrast.
JetBrains Mono only for plates, trip ids, counts, and the clock.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Body text is ink or ink-soft on light glass, and near-white on dark glass. Gray on a tinted surface is not a secondary color.

rules.name: The Data Face Rule
rules.body: Mono is for identifiers, durations, and counts. Labels stay in the UI face.

dos: Do keep real trip, plate, and site data in the glass. Do not paste sample counts from the mock.
Do use the shared shell for every app. Do not rebuild warehouse, gate, or driver into the tower's five-column layouts.
Do pair a status color with a word.
donts: Don't put a left stripe on cards or nav items.
Don't use IBM Plex, gradient text, or a flat white page behind the panels.
Don't put small white type on Apple green or Apple orange.
